```{r load-data, results='asis'}
## FIRST SYNC ONEDRIVE FOLDER
## !!!ADD LOCAL PATH INFORMATION HERE FOR TOOL'S ZIP FILE AND JSON ON ONEDRIVE
mypath <- here::here("data")

## !!!ADJUST FOR WHICHEVER TOOL
# Find the most recent local ToolC data file (csv or csv.zip)
tool_c_files <- list.files(
  mypath, 
  pattern = "^hfe-tool-c-final_\\d{8}\\.(csv|csv\\.zip)$", 
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(tool_c_files) == 0) {
  stop("No local Tool C file found in ", mypath, 
       " — run the pull-and-archive script first.")
}

# Extract the date suffix and take the latest
file_dates <- str_extract(tool_c_files, "\\d{8}")
latest_file <- tool_c_files[which.max(as.Date(file_dates, format = "%Y%m%d"))]

# Load the matching metadata sidecar for the true pull timestamp
meta_file <- sub("\\.(csv\\.zip|csv)$", ".meta.json", latest_file)
if (file.exists(meta_file)) {
  meta <- jsonlite::fromJSON(meta_file)
  pull_time <- as.POSIXct(meta$pulled_at, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z")
} else {
  warning("No metadata sidecar found for ", latest_file, "; using file mtime instead.")
  pull_time <- file.info(latest_file)$mtime
}

# Read the data — handle zip vs plain csv
if (grepl("\\.zip$", latest_file)) {
  exdir <- tempfile(); dir.create(exdir)
  csv_files <- unzip(latest_file, exdir = exdir) %>% 
    grep("\\.csv$", ., ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  tables <- setNames(
    lapply(csv_files, readr::read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE),
    tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(csv_files))
  )
} else {
  tables <- setNames(
    list(readr::read_csv(latest_file, show_col_types = FALSE)),
    tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(latest_file))
  )
}

## !!!!ADJUST FOR WHICHEVER TOOL
dat <- tables$`hfe-tool-c-final`
dat_q27 <- tables$`hfe-tool-c-final-dth_review_repeat`
```

```{r pull-summary, results='asis'}
# Summary of this data pull: when it happened, how many entries came in,
# and which facilities (by name) have submitted at least one entry.
# facility_lookup comes from the facility-lookup chunk above.

facility_codes_in_pull <- unique(str_extract(dat$f03, "(?<=-)[A-Z]+(?=-)"))
facility_codes_in_pull <- facility_codes_in_pull[!is.na(facility_codes_in_pull)]
facility_names_in_pull <- sort(unname(facility_lookup[facility_codes_in_pull]))

cat("**Data pulled:**", format(pull_time, "%B %d, %Y at %I:%M %p %Z"), "\n\n")
cat("**Entries (rows):**", nrow(dat), "\n\n")
cat("**Facilities with entries:**", paste(facility_names_in_pull, collapse = "; "))
```

```{r conditions}
# Intro -------------------------------------------------------------------

cond_level1 <- (is.na(dat$level1) | trimws(dat$level1) == "")
# t_level1: flag when level1 has a value but the choice-name lookup failed (mismatched/invalid code)
cond_t_level1 <- !is.na(dat$level1) & trimws(dat$level1) != "" & (is.na(dat$t_level1) | trimws(dat$t_level1) == "")
cond_level2 <- (is.na(dat$level2) | trimws(dat$level2) == "")
cond_level3 <- (is.na(dat$level3) | trimws(dat$level3) == "")
cond_g01 <- (is.na(dat$g01) | trimws(dat$g01) == "")
cond_g02 <- (is.na(dat$g02) | trimws(dat$g02) == "")
cond_g03 <- (is.na(dat$g03) | trimws(dat$g03) == "")

# Recruitment and consent --------------------------------------------------

# check consent/recruit and flag any "filled out anyway" violations on the fullL dataset
cond_recruit <- (is.na(dat$recruit) | trimws(dat$recruit) == "")
cond_neg_consent <- !is.na(dat$recruit) & dat$recruit != "1" & !is.na(dat$consent)
cond_consent <- !is.na(dat$recruit) & dat$recruit == "1" & (is.na(dat$consent) | trimws(dat$consent) == "")

# identify rows where consent was given
consented <- !is.na(dat$recruit) & dat$recruit == "1" & !is.na(dat$consent) & dat$consent == "1"

# spot-check a sample of variables spanning the different sections of the group. 
# flag if any of these has a value despite no consent
sample_post_consent_cols <- intersect(
  c("f01", "f04", "signature",
    "q11", "q13a", "q15", "q17", "q18",
    "q21m", "q22a", "q25", "q211", "q214", "q220",
    "q234", "q243a6i", "q246", "q250", "q252", "q254",
    "m242a1_m1"),
  names(dat)
)

any_filled_despite_no_consent <- Reduce(`|`, lapply(sample_post_consent_cols, function(col) {
  x <- dat[[col]]
  !is.na(x) & trimws(as.character(x)) != ""
}))
cond_consent_violation <- !consented & any_filled_despite_no_consent

# Filter to consented -----------------------------------------------------

# Filter to consented rows -- all remaining checks in this script assume this.
dat <- dat[consented, , drop = FALSE]

# Facility info / consent artifacts 
cond_signature <- (is.na(dat$signature) | trimws(dat$signature) == "")
cond_f01 <- (is.na(dat$f01) | trimws(dat$f01) == "")

# t_f01: lookup for f01
cond_t_f01 <- !is.na(dat$f01) & trimws(dat$f01) != "" & (is.na(dat$t_f01) | trimws(dat$t_f01) == "")

# f03: facility ID variable (built from g03s + f01)
cond_f03 <- (is.na(dat$f03) | trimws(dat$f03) == "")
cond_f03_dup <- !is.na(dat$f03) & trimws(dat$f03) != "" &  (duplicated(dat$f03) | duplicated(dat$f03, fromLast = TRUE))

cond_f04 <- (is.na(dat$f04) | trimws(dat$f04) == "")
cond_f04oth <- !is.na(dat$f04) & dat$f04 == "96" & (is.na(dat$f04oth) | trimws(dat$f04oth) == "")

# GPS capture: flag if latitude or longitude is blank/NA (a visit with no
# location captured at all). Altitude/accuracy aren't required for this check.
cond_gps_blank <- (is.na(dat$`gps-Latitude`) | trimws(dat$`gps-Latitude`) == "") |
                   (is.na(dat$`gps-Longitude`) | trimws(dat$`gps-Longitude`) == "")



# Section 1: System characteristics ---------------------------------------

# System characteristics intro
cond_q11  <- (is.na(dat$q11) | trimws(dat$q11) == "")
cond_q11a <- !is.na(dat$q11) & dat$q11 == "2" & (is.na(dat$q11a) | trimws(dat$q11a) == "")
cond_q12  <- (is.na(dat$q12) | trimws(dat$q12) == "")
cond_q12a <- !is.na(dat$q12) & dat$q12 == "2" & (is.na(dat$q12a) | trimws(dat$q12a) == "")

# Helper: flags an attempted "missing" code that isn't the exact designated
# code (9999) for the q13*1 year-captured fields -- e.g. an extra/dropped digit
# (99999, 999), or the wrong code entirely (8888, the code used elsewhere in this form for the m242 monthly count fields).
is_improper_missing_year <- function(x) {
  xc <- trimws(as.character(x))
  !is.na(x) & xc != "" & (
    (grepl("^9+$", xc) & xc != "9999") |
    (xc == "8888")
  )
}

# Maternal death capture
cond_q13a <- (is.na(dat$q13a) | trimws(dat$q13a) == "")
cond_neg_q13awhy <- !is.na(dat$q13a) & dat$q13a == "0" & (is.na(dat$q13awhy) | trimws(dat$q13awhy) == "")
# !!!!!!FLAG: the "year captured" field is named q13a6 in BOTH the q13agrp and q13bgrp groups
# (should be q13a1 / q13b1). 
# Currently renaming them using column position
# re-verify the ...31 / ...36 suffixes after every pull-data, since they depend on total column count up to that point
dat$q13a1 <- dat$`q13a6...31`
dat$q13b1 <- dat$`q13a6...36`
cond_q13a1_ca <- !is.na(dat$q13a) & dat$q13a == "1" & (is.na(dat$q13a1) | trimws(dat$q13a1) == "")
cond_q13a1_cb <- !is.na(dat$q13a) & dat$q13a == "1" & (!is.na(dat$q13a1) & (as.numeric(dat$q13a1) >= 2027 & as.numeric(dat$q13a1) != 9999))
# Flagging an implausibly early year
cond_q13a1_soft1990 <- !is.na(dat$q13a) & dat$q13a == "1" & (!is.na(dat$q13a1) & as.numeric(dat$q13a1) < 1990 & as.numeric(dat$q13a1) != 9999)
cond_q13a1_impropermissing <- !is.na(dat$q13a) & dat$q13a == "1" & is_improper_missing_year(dat$q13a1)
cond_q13a2 <- !is.na(dat$q13a) & dat$q13a == "1" & (is.na(dat$q13a2) | trimws(dat$q13a2) == "")
cond_q14a <- !is.na(dat$q13a) & dat$q13a == "1" & (is.na(dat$q14a) | trimws(dat$q14a) == "")

# Stillbirth capture
cond_q13b <- (is.na(dat$q13b) | trimws(dat$q13b) == "")
cond_neg_q13bwhy <- !is.na(dat$q13b) & dat$q13b == "0" & (is.na(dat$q13bwhy) | trimws(dat$q13bwhy) == "")
cond_q13b1_ca <- !is.na(dat$q13b) & dat$q13b == "1" & (is.na(dat$q13b1) | trimws(dat$q13b1) == "")
cond_q13b1_cb <- !is.na(dat$q13b) & dat$q13b == "1" & (!is.na(dat$q13b1) & (as.numeric(dat$q13b1) >= 2027 & as.numeric(dat$q13b1) != 9999))
cond_q13b1_soft1990 <- !is.na(dat$q13b) & dat$q13b == "1" & (!is.na(dat$q13b1) & as.numeric(dat$q13b1) < 1990 & as.numeric(dat$q13b1) != 9999)
cond_q13b1_impropermissing <- !is.na(dat$q13b) & dat$q13b == "1" & is_improper_missing_year(dat$q13b1)
cond_q13b2 <- !is.na(dat$q13b) & dat$q13b == "1" & (is.na(dat$q13b2) | trimws(dat$q13b2) == "")
cond_q14b <- !is.na(dat$q13b) & dat$q13b == "1" & (is.na(dat$q14b) | trimws(dat$q14b) == "")

# Neonatal deaths
cond_q13c <- (is.na(dat$q13c) | trimws(dat$q13c) == "")
cond_neg_q13cwhy <- !is.na(dat$q13c) & dat$q13c == "0" & (is.na(dat$q13cwhy) | trimws(dat$q13cwhy) == "")
cond_q13c1_ca <- !is.na(dat$q13c) & dat$q13c == "1" & (is.na(dat$q13c1) | trimws(dat$q13c1) == "")
cond_q13c1_cb <- !is.na(dat$q13c) & dat$q13c == "1" & (!is.na(dat$q13c1) & (as.numeric(dat$q13c1) >= 2027 & as.numeric(dat$q13c1) != 9999))
cond_q13c1_soft1990 <- !is.na(dat$q13c) & dat$q13c == "1" & (!is.na(dat$q13c1) & as.numeric(dat$q13c1) < 1990 & as.numeric(dat$q13c1) != 9999)
cond_q13c1_impropermissing <- !is.na(dat$q13c) & dat$q13c == "1" & is_improper_missing_year(dat$q13c1)
cond_q13c2 <- !is.na(dat$q13c) & dat$q13c == "1" & (is.na(dat$q13c2) | trimws(dat$q13c2) == "")
cond_q14c <- !is.na(dat$q13c) & dat$q13c == "1" & (is.na(dat$q14c) | trimws(dat$q14c) == "")

# Child deaths
cond_q13d <- (is.na(dat$q13d) | trimws(dat$q13d) == "")
cond_neg_q13dwhy <- !is.na(dat$q13d) & dat$q13d == "0" & (is.na(dat$q13dwhy) | trimws(dat$q13dwhy) == "")
cond_q13d1_ca <- !is.na(dat$q13d) & dat$q13d == "1" & (is.na(dat$q13d1) | trimws(dat$q13d1) == "")
cond_q13d1_cb <- !is.na(dat$q13d) & dat$q13d == "1" & (!is.na(dat$q13d1) & (as.numeric(dat$q13d1) >= 2027 & as.numeric(dat$q13d1) != 9999))
cond_q13d1_soft1990 <- !is.na(dat$q13d) & dat$q13d == "1" & (!is.na(dat$q13d1) & as.numeric(dat$q13d1) < 1990 & as.numeric(dat$q13d1) != 9999)
cond_q13d1_impropermissing <- !is.na(dat$q13d) & dat$q13d == "1" & is_improper_missing_year(dat$q13d1)
cond_q13d2 <- !is.na(dat$q13d) & dat$q13d == "1" & (is.na(dat$q13d2) | trimws(dat$q13d2) == "")
cond_q14d <- !is.na(dat$q13d) & dat$q13d == "1" & (is.na(dat$q14d) | trimws(dat$q14d) == "")

# MPCDSR training, mentoring, supervision, electronic or paper-based
cond_q15 <- (is.na(dat$q15) | trimws(dat$q15) == "")
cond_neg_q15a <- !is.na(dat$q15) & dat$q15 == "0" & !is.na(dat$q15a)
cond_q15a <- !is.na(dat$q15) & dat$q15 != "0" & (is.na(dat$q15a) | trimws(dat$q15a) == "")
cond_q16 <- (is.na(dat$q16) | trimws(dat$q16) == "")
cond_q17 <- (is.na(dat$q17) | trimws(dat$q17) == "")
cond_neg_q17a <- !is.na(dat$q17) & dat$q17 == "0" & !is.na(dat$q17a)
cond_q17a <- !is.na(dat$q17) & dat$q17 != "0" & (is.na(dat$q17a) | trimws(dat$q17a) == "")
cond_q17aoth <- !is.na(dat$q17a) & grepl("(^|\\s)96(\\s|$)", dat$q17a) & (is.na(dat$q17aoth) | trimws(dat$q17aoth) == "")
cond_q18 <- (is.na(dat$q18) | trimws(dat$q18) == "")
cond_q19 <- !is.na(dat$q18) & (dat$q18 == "2" | dat$q18 == "3") & (is.na(dat$q19) | trimws(dat$q19) == "")
cond_q19oth <- !is.na(dat$q19) & grepl("(^|\\s)96(\\s|$)", dat$q19) & (is.na(dat$q19oth) | trimws(dat$q19oth) == "")

# Section 2: implementation -----------------------------------------------

# How identified
cond_q21m <- (is.na(dat$q21m) | trimws(dat$q21m) == "")
cond_q21oth <- !is.na(dat$q21m) & grepl("(^|\\s)96(\\s|$)", dat$q21m) &
  (is.na(dat$q21oth) | trimws(dat$q21oth) == "")

# How soon notified facility deaths
cond_q22a <- !is.na(dat$q13a) & dat$q13a == "1" & (is.na(dat$q22a) | trimws(dat$q22a) == "")
cond_q22aoth <- !is.na(dat$q22a) & grepl("(^|\\s)96(\\s|$)", dat$q22a) &
  (is.na(dat$q22aoth) | trimws(dat$q22aoth) == "")
cond_q22b <- !is.na(dat$q13b) & dat$q13b == "1" & (is.na(dat$q22b) | trimws(dat$q22b) == "")

  (is.na(dat$q22both) | trimws(dat$q22both) == "")
cond_q22c <- !is.na(dat$q13c) & dat$q13c == "1" & (is.na(dat$q22c) | trimws(dat$q22c) == "")

# q27 has one row per repeat instance
# while the file used in the rest of this script is one row per submission
# needs its own check_defs/conditions/results rather than being merged into the main
check_defs_q27 <- tribble(
  ~cond_name,      ~question,       ~label,                                 ~issue,
  "cond_get_death1", "q25a / get_death1", "Death type label", "get_death1 is NA but q27 answers exist for this repeat instance",
  
  "cond_q27a",       "q27a",         "Who participates in review",           "Who participates is blank (q27a)",
  "cond_q27ango",    "q27a / q27ango",   "NGO rep specify (participants)",    "NGO/Managing Authority Rep selected (q27a=17) but q27ango is blank",
  "cond_q27anun",    "q27a / q27anun",   "UN rep specify (participants)",     "UN Agency Rep selected (q27a=18) but q27anun is blank",
  "cond_q27anlmoh",  "q27a / q27anlmoh", "LGA MOH rep specify (participants)","LGA MoH Rep selected (q27a=19) but q27anlmoh is blank",
  "cond_q27ansmoh",  "q27a / q27ansmoh", "State MOH rep specify (participants)", "State MoH Rep selected (q27a=20) but q27ansmoh is blank",
  "cond_q27annmoh",  "q27a / q27annmoh", "National MOH rep specify (participants)", "National MoH Rep selected (q27a=21) but q27annmoh is blank",
  "cond_q27anoth",   "q27a / q27anoth",  "Other specify (participants)",      "Other selected (q27a=96) but q27anoth is blank",
  
  "cond_q27b",       "q27b",         "How frequently reviewed",              "How frequently reviewed is blank (q27b)",
  "cond_q27both",    "q27b / q27both", "How frequently reviewed other",      "Other selected (q27b=96) but q27both is blank",
  
  "cond_q27c",       "q27c",         "How many reviewed",                    "How many reviewed is blank (q27c)",
  "cond_q27csample", "q27c / q27csample", "Sample size specify",             "Sample of deaths selected (q27c=2) but q27csample is blank",
  "cond_q27coth",    "q27c / q27coth",    "How many reviewed other",         "Other selected (q27c=96) but q27coth is blank",
  
  "cond_q27d",       "q27d",         "Sources used to collect information",  "Sources used is blank (q27d)",
  "cond_q27doth",    "q27d / q27doth", "Sources used other",                 "Other selected (q27d=96) but q27doth is blank",
  
  "cond_q27e",       "q27e",         "Who compiles information",             "Who compiles information is blank (q27e)",
  "cond_q27engo",    "q27a / q27engo",   "NGO rep specify (compiler) [FLAG: gated on q27a]",    "NGO/Managing Authority Rep selected (q27a=17) but q27engo is blank -- NOTE: form bug, this should gate on q27e",
  "cond_q27enun",    "q27a / q27enun",   "UN rep specify (compiler) [FLAG: gated on q27a]",     "UN Agency Rep selected (q27a=18) but q27enun is blank -- NOTE: form bug, this should gate on q27e",
  "cond_q27enlmoh",  "q27a / q27enlmoh", "LGA MOH rep specify (compiler) [FLAG: gated on q27a]","LGA MoH Rep selected (q27a=19) but q27enlmoh is blank -- NOTE: form bug, this should gate on q27e",
  "cond_q27ensmoh",  "q27a / q27ensmoh", "State MOH rep specify (compiler) [FLAG: gated on q27a]", "State MoH Rep selected (q27a=20) but q27ensmoh is blank -- NOTE: form bug, this should gate on q27e",
  "cond_q27ennmoh",  "q27a / q27ennmoh", "National MOH rep specify (compiler) [FLAG: gated on q27a]", "National MoH Rep selected (q27a=21) but q27ennmoh is blank -- NOTE: form bug, this should gate on q27e",
  "cond_q27enoth",   "q27a / q27enoth",  "Other specify (compiler) [FLAG: gated on q27a]", "Other selected (q27a=96) but q27enoth is blank -- NOTE: form bug, this should gate on q27e",
  
  "cond_q27f",       "q27f",         "When death type last reviewed",        "When last reviewed is blank (q27f)"
)

conditions_q27 <- mget(check_defs_q27$cond_name)

section_q27_results <- check_defs_q27 %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(cond_name, question, label, issue) {
    flagged <- which(conditions_q27[[cond_name]])
    if (length(flagged) == 0) return(NULL)
    tibble(
      KEY         = dat_outcomes$KEY[flagged],
      PARENT_KEY  = dat_outcomes$PARENT_KEY[flagged],
      f03         = dat_outcomes$f03[flagged],
      get_death1  = dat_outcomes$get_death1[flagged],
      question    = question,
      label       = label,
      issue       = issue
    )
  })

# q242 --------------------------------------------------------------------

# Groups monthgrp_2_42a1...monthgrp_2_42c9, ~26 indicator families x 12 months.

# Rather than flagging each month individually (too noisy when many months are blank), we flag 4 consolidated conditions per family:
#   - some months invalid (non-numeric or negative)
#   - all months invalid
#   - some months blank/NA
#   - all months blank/NA
# 8888 is the expected "not available/missing" code and is NOT flagged as invalid.

is_blank_val <- function(x) {
  is.na(x) | trimws(as.character(x)) == ""
}

is_invalid_val <- function(x) {
  # non-blank, but non-numeric junk or negative. 8888 is numeric and >=0, so it's valid.
  num_x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  !is_blank_val(x) & (is.na(num_x) | num_x < 0)
}

is_high_val <- function(x, max_plausible = 50) {
  # non-blank, valid number, not the 8888 "not applicable" code, and above a
  # plausible monthly count for a single facility. Tune max_plausible if a
  # legitimately busy facility clears this on the higher-volume indicators.
  num_x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  !is_blank_val(x) & !is.na(num_x) & num_x != 8888 & num_x > max_plausible
}

is_improper_missing_val <- function(x) {
  # Catches an attempted "missing" code that isn't the exact designated
  # code (8888) for this field -- e.g. an extra/dropped digit (88888, 888),
  # or the wrong code entirely (9999, which is the code used elsewhere
  # in this form for the q13*1 "year" fields). These pass the is_invalid_val()
  # check above (non-negative, numeric) and would otherwise slip through
  # silently as a plausible count.
  xc <- trimws(as.character(x))
  !is_blank_val(x) & (
    (grepl("^8+$", xc) & xc != "8888") |
    (xc == "9999")
  )
}

month_conditions <- list()

month_check_defs <- pmap_dfr(month_families, function(prefix, gate_var, label_stub) {
  
  cols <- paste0(prefix, "_m", 1:12)
  present_cols <- cols[cols %in% names(dat)]
  if (length(present_cols) == 0) return(tibble())  # family not in this export yet
  
  gate <- if (is.na(gate_var)) {
    rep(TRUE, nrow(dat))
  } else if (gate_var %in% names(dat)) {
    !is.na(dat[[gate_var]]) & as.numeric(dat[[gate_var]]) > 0
  } else {
    rep(FALSE, nrow(dat))  # gate variable missing from export -- can't evaluate, so don't flag
  }
  
  n_present <- length(present_cols)
  
  blank_matrix            <- sapply(present_cols, function(cn) is_blank_val(dat[[cn]]))
  invalid_matrix          <- sapply(present_cols, function(cn) is_invalid_val(dat[[cn]]))
  high_matrix             <- sapply(present_cols, function(cn) is_high_val(dat[[cn]]))
  improper_missing_matrix <- sapply(present_cols, function(cn) is_improper_missing_val(dat[[cn]]))
  if (is.null(dim(blank_matrix)))            blank_matrix            <- matrix(blank_matrix,            ncol = n_present)
  if (is.null(dim(invalid_matrix)))          invalid_matrix          <- matrix(invalid_matrix,          ncol = n_present)
  if (is.null(dim(high_matrix)))             high_matrix             <- matrix(high_matrix,             ncol = n_present)
  if (is.null(dim(improper_missing_matrix))) improper_missing_matrix <- matrix(improper_missing_matrix, ncol = n_present)
  
  # A cell caught by the improper-missing check (e.g. 9999, 88888) is an
  # attempted missing-value entry, not a real count -- don't also count it
  # toward "implausibly high" so it only trips the one, more specific flag.
  high_matrix <- high_matrix & !improper_missing_matrix
  
  n_blank             <- rowSums(blank_matrix)
  n_invalid           <- rowSums(invalid_matrix)
  n_high              <- rowSums(high_matrix)
  n_improper_missing  <- rowSums(improper_missing_matrix)
  
  all_blank            <- n_blank == n_present
  some_blank           <- n_blank > 0 & n_blank < n_present
  all_invalid          <- n_invalid == n_present
  some_invalid         <- n_invalid > 0 & n_invalid < n_present
  some_high            <- n_high > 0
  some_improper_missing <- n_improper_missing > 0
  
  make_row <- function(suffix, flag_vec, label_suffix, issue_suffix) {
    cond_name <- paste0("cond_", prefix, "_", suffix)
    month_conditions[[cond_name]] <<- gate & flag_vec
    tibble(
      cond_name = cond_name,
      question  = paste(present_cols, collapse = ", "),
      label     = paste0(label_stub, " - ", label_suffix),
      issue     = paste0(label_stub, " ", issue_suffix, " (", prefix, ")")
    )
  }
  
  bind_rows(
    make_row("somemonths_invalid", some_invalid, "some months invalid",
             "has some (but not all) months with non-numeric or negative values"),
    make_row("allmonths_invalid",  all_invalid,  "all months invalid",
             "has non-numeric or negative values for all available months"),
    make_row("somemonths_missing", some_blank,   "some months blank/NA",
             "is blank/NA for some (but not all) available months"),
    make_row("allmonths_missing",  all_blank,    "all months blank/NA",
             "is blank/NA for all available months"),
    make_row("somemonths_high",    some_high,    "implausibly high month value",
             "has a month value other than 8888 that looks implausibly high (>50)"),
    make_row("somemonths_impropermissing", some_improper_missing, "improper missing value used",
             "has a month value that appears to be an attempted missing-value entry (e.g., 88888, or 9999) rather than the designated missing code of 8888 -- an improper missing value was used")
  )
})

# Helper: flags NA, non-numeric, or negative values in a column
flag_invalid_numeric <- function(x) {
  num_x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  is.na(x) | trimws(x) == "" | (is.na(num_x) & !is.na(x)) | (!is.na(num_x) & num_x < 0)
}

# Combine main and monthly conditions -------------------------------------

# main condition names were captured in check_defs before this section
main_cond_names <- check_defs$cond_name

check_defs <- bind_rows(check_defs, month_check_defs)
conditions <- c(mget(main_cond_names), month_conditions)

# format individual-level results
tool_results <- check_defs %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(cond_name, question, label, issue) {
    flagged <- which(conditions[[cond_name]])
    if (length(flagged) == 0) return(NULL)
    tibble(
      KEY = dat$KEY[flagged],
      f03 = dat$f03[flagged],
      question       = question,
      label          = label,
      issue          = issue
    )
  })

# Combine q27 with rest ---------------------------------------------------

# q27 is at the repeat-instance level (one row per death type reviewed per submission)
# create one summary row per submission/death type combination
# (not one row per individual sub-question flagged)
# collapse section_q27_results down, concatenating all the flagged sub-issues into a single issue string
# use PARENT_KEY as KEY so it lines up with the submission-level KEY used everywhere else in tool_results
if (nrow(section_q27_results) > 0) {
  section_q27_collapsed <- section_q27_results %>%
    group_by(KEY, PARENT_KEY, f03, get_death1) %>%
    summarise(issue = paste(issue, collapse = " | "), .groups = "drop") %>%
    transmute(
      KEY      = PARENT_KEY,
      f03      = f03,
      question = "q27",
      label    = paste0("Death review repeat (", get_death1, ")"),
      issue    = paste0(issue)
    )
  
  tool_results <- bind_rows(tool_results, section_q27_collapsed)
}
```

```{r compare-to-previous}

# Compare against previous day's flagged queries ---------------------------

# Snapshots are dated (one file per day), so re-running multiple times in
# one day always compares against the most recent prior day's snapshot,
# not against something written earlier today.

snapshot_dir <- here::here("gen", "monitoring", "query_snapshots")
if (!dir.exists(snapshot_dir)) dir.create(snapshot_dir, recursive = TRUE)

today_str <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")
today_snapshot_path <- file.path(snapshot_dir, sprintf("toolC_query_snapshot_%s.csv", today_str))

# find snapshot files from any day BEFORE today
existing_snapshots <- list.files(snapshot_dir, pattern = "^toolC_query_snapshot_\\d{8}\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
snapshot_dates <- str_extract(basename(existing_snapshots), "\\d{8}")
prior_snapshots <- existing_snapshots[snapshot_dates < today_str]

if (length(prior_snapshots) > 0) {
  # most recent prior day
  latest_prior <- prior_snapshots[which.max(as.Date(snapshot_dates[snapshot_dates < today_str], format = "%Y%m%d"))]
  previous_snapshot <- readr::read_csv(latest_prior, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  previous_snapshot <- tibble(KEY = character(), question = character(), label = character())
}

# full set of issues flagged in THIS pull, before filtering to "new only"
tool_results_full <- tool_results

# queries not present in the most recent PRIOR day's snapshot = new
tool_results_new <- tool_results_full %>%
  anti_join(previous_snapshot, by = c("KEY", "question", "label"))

# always (over)write TODAY's snapshot — safe to run multiple times a day,
# since the comparison baseline above only ever looks at prior days
readr::write_csv(
  tool_results_full %>% 
    select(KEY, question, label) %>%
    mutate(data_pulled_at = format(pull_time, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z")),
  today_snapshot_path
)

# !!!!!! generate Word doc report with all queries or just new?
# all
tool_results <- tool_results_full
# just new
#tool_results <- tool_results_new

# No-issues placeholder ----------------------------------------------------

if (nrow(tool_results) == 0) {
  if (nrow(tool_results_full) == 0) {
    tool_results <- tibble(
      KEY = NA_character_, 
      f03 = NA_character_, 
      question = NA_character_,
      label = "No issues found", 
      issue = "All checks passed -- no flags raised"
    )
  } else {
    tool_results <- tibble(
      KEY = NA_character_,
      f03 = NA_character_, 
      question = NA_character_,
      label = "No new issues", 
      issue = "No new data queries since the previous report"
    )
  }
}
```

```{r create-table}
# define flextable
fn_make_flextable <- function(dat) {
  dat  %>%
    select(-KEY) %>%
    mutate(
        facility_code = str_extract(f03, "(?<=-)[A-Z]+(?=-)"),
        facility_name = facility_lookup[facility_code],
        comments = NA_character_
      ) %>%
    arrange(facility_name, f03) %>%
    select(facility_name, f03, question, label, issue, comments) %>%
    flextable() %>%
    set_table_properties(layout = "fixed", width = 1) %>%
    width(j = "facility_name", width = 1.3) %>%
    width(j = "f03",           width = 1.1) %>%
    width(j = "question",      width = 1.5) %>%
    width(j = "label",         width = 1.4) %>%
    width(j = "issue",         width = 2.7) %>%
    width(j = "comments",      width = 2.0) %>%
    fit_to_width(max_width = 10) %>%
    width(j = "comments", width = 1.3) %>% 
    fontsize(size = 7, part = "all") %>%
    bold(part = "header") %>%
    bg(bg = "#4472C4", part = "header") %>%
    color(color = "white", part = "header") %>%
    valign(valign = "top", part = "body") %>%
    padding(padding = 3, part = "all") %>%
    border_inner_h(border = officer::fp_border(color = "black", width = 1), part = "body") %>%
    border_inner_v(border = officer::fp_border(color = "black", width = 1), part = "all")
    
    
    #font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
    #fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") %>%
    #padding(padding = 2, part = "all") %>%
    #border_inner_h(border = officer::fp_border(color = "black", width = 1), part = "body") %>%
    #border_inner_v(border = officer::fp_border(color = "black", width = 1), part = "all")
}

fn_make_flextable(tool_results)
```
